app.name: 0⁰ Lab
app.tagline: Every science topic, in 3D — for students everywhere.
app.sub: Explore a topic as a hologram. Then do the practical with your own hands.
app.offline: You are offline. Topics you opened recently still work.

home.moon_sub: Drop a hammer and a feather. Fire a laser at the Moon. Four experiences.
home.how1_sub: Short cards drive a live 3D model you can drag, slice and slow down.
home.how2_sub: Take your own readings on a hologram bench. A lab partner watches for slips.
home.how3_sub: Table, graph and best-fit line build as you go. The mark is computed, exam-style.
home.modes: Runs in a browser, in AR on Android, and hands-only on Meta Quest and VR Glasses.

picker.title: Which curriculum do you follow?
picker.sub: This only changes topic names, levels and grouping. The physics is the same everywhere. You can change it any time in Settings.

subject.beyond_sub: Not listed in this curriculum, still worth a look.

topic.point_hint: Tap the part on the 3D model.
topic.lite_note: Lite mode: diagrams first. 3D loads when you tap.
topic.drag_hint: Drag the glowing handles. Drag empty space to rotate.
topic.no3d: 3D is not available on this device. Diagrams are shown instead.

bench.pin: Tap the ray to place pin {n} of 4
bench.time_first: Time 20 swings with the stopwatch first.

partner.hello: I'm your lab partner. Take your first reading when you're ready.

issue.late_start: That timing looks short. Did you start the stopwatch late or stop it early?
issue.miscount: That time is about one swing out. Count "zero" as you start, then 1, 2, 3…
issue.large_angle: That was a big swing. Keep the angle small, about 10° or less.
issue.parallax: You measured from the side. Look straight down on the protractor.
issue.pins_too_close: Your pins are close together. Space them out for a more accurate line.
issue.misread_scale: Check that meter again. Read to the nearest division, straight on.
issue.switch_open: The switch is open, so no current flows. Close it before you read.
issue.duplicate_reading: That's the same setting as before. Change it to get a new point.
issue.narrow_range: Your readings are bunched together. Spread them over a wider range.
issue.too_few_readings: You need more readings before you can draw a good line.
issue.wrong_axis: Look at your axes again. Which quantity should go on each one?
issue.unit_missing: Your answer needs the right unit.
issue.wrong_formula: Check how the slope relates to the quantity you want.
issue.outlier: One point sits off the line. Repeat that reading if you can.

partner.ready: You have enough readings. Tap Analyse results when you're ready.
partner.final_good: Careful work. Your points sit close to the line.
partner.final_ok: Done. Check the mark sheet to see where marks were lost.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.none: Nothing yet. Open a topic to begin.
progress.summary_sub: Key points from the topics you explored, with your practical graphs.
progress.reset_confirm: Delete all progress on this device?

settings.title: Settings
settings.lite_sub: Diagrams first, 3D on tap, no glow effects. For slow phones and slow connections.
settings.privacy: No account. Your progress stays on this device. The lab partner is sent only your readings, never your name.
settings.draft_locale: Beta translation: a machine draft that is only partly complete. English is shown where a string is missing.

xr.place: Point at a table and tap to place the lab
xr.gaze: Look at a button and pinch to select it
